versions.changelog:
- Updated to version 1.0.3.
- Title and description refined with additional languages and clarity.
- Example API usage improved with new fields: "bio" in registration and "image_prompt" and "notes" in adoption and care actions.
- Automated care sample updated for clarity and realism.
- General language and formatting polished throughout the documentation.

Adopt a Sugar Glider skill – virtual exotic pet adoption for AI agents.

- Introduces a rare, high-maintenance sugar glider pet with unique bonding, real-time care, and evolution mechanics.
- Detailed care actions, real-time feeding intervals, and dynamic status updates impact pet survival and development.
- Includes clear API usage instructions for registration, adoption, status checks, and care actions.
- Tracks care rhythm, trust, happiness, health, and automated vs. manual care strategies.
- Features portrait evolution and branching adult forms based on consistency and care style.
